name: Admin Standalone Email Composer
description: Admin composes and sends one branded email from /panel/emails to one or more visible Para recipients and optional CC recipients. The shared hybrid picker searches registered clients or accepts manual addresses, rejects duplicates/placeholders, and enforces 10 unique addresses across both headers. Page-level tabs (Redactar / Historial / Valores por defecto, deep-linked via ?tab=). Redactar also supports draggable sections with per-section Markdown, file attachments and server-rendered preview. Historial groups all visible destinations under one delivery. Endpoints: emails/send/, emails/preview/, emails/defaults/, emails/history/. History distinguishes an unfiltered empty archive from applied filters with no matches, including email deep links and the false attachment filter; unapplied edits do not change the result message and Limpiar restores the unfiltered list (PA-233).
knownGaps: Spec does not exercise: add/remove/drag-reorder sections, send-error path, history entry expand/collapse, "Cargar más" pagination. Attachments split out to admin-standalone-email-attachments (2026-07-16 audit).
